text: Aiko's dad had a fall on Saturday and fractured his wrist. He's in a cast for six weeks and she's driving over every evening after work to cook and help him wash. Her brother Jakub lives in Leeds so can't do much. She sounded shattered. Text her on Thursday to see how he's getting on.

Eduardo and Lila are celebrating ten years married on June 3rd. They're thinking of going back to Lisbon, where they had the honeymoon, and Lila wants to surprise him with a vow renewal while they're there. She's asked me to keep it quiet and maybe help her find a photographer out there.
Remind me to call Uma the day before her mum's knee replacement. It's booked for March 12.
Phoebe got engaged! Theo proposed on the beach in Cornwall last weekend. She said she cried so much she couldn't actually say yes for a minute.
Santiago's little girl has chickenpox, so he's off work all week. Poor thing is miserable and won't stop scratching.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Friday and book the car in for its MOT.
Georgia mentioned that Niamh's wedding has been called off. Apparently they split up in August and she's only just telling people. Must message Niamh this week, gently.
Ali is a huge cricket fan and supports Yorkshire. He also does all the cooking at home, mostly Pakistani food his mum taught him.
Mai's son Hoang broke his collarbone at rugby on Tuesday. Surgery is on 11/4 and she's understandably anxious. I should drop round with some food the evening after.
Arjun and his fiancée Ruby are getting married on May 14 next year. Save the dates are going out soon.
Rachel has been off sick with long Covid since the summer. She says some days she can barely get off the sofa, but she's trying a graded return to work in January.
Don't forget the anniversary card for Mum and Dad. Their thirty-fifth is on the 28th, and I need to post it the week before so it arrives in time.
Quick note after talking to Jorge: his wife Tamar is pregnant with their second, due in April. Their eldest, Luca, is four and very excited about being a big brother.
Luis has a scan on the 22nd to check on the lump in his neck. He's trying to play it down but he's clearly worried. Remind me to text him that morning, and then ring him a couple of days afterwards.
Magda's dog Biscuit had to have a tumour removed. The vet says it went well and he's home now wearing a cone.
Ioana said her grandmother passed away on Sunday. The funeral is in Bucharest next Friday and she's flying out on Wednesday.
Adebayo and Yetunde renewed their vows in Lagos last month for their twentieth anniversary. Ask Yetunde for the photos next time I see her.
Ethan's knee is still bad after the half marathon. He's seeing a physio on October 30th.
Sara loves anything to do with gardening, especially roses. She's been hinting she'd really like a decent pair of secateurs.

Coffee with Alfie. He's just started at a new firm in Manchester, doing structural engineering. Seems happy but the commute is long, over an hour each way on the train, and he's thinking about moving closer in the new year. His girlfriend Phoebe is a teacher in Stockport, so they'd probably look somewhere between the two.
Rafael proposed to Uma on her birthday, August 9. The engagement party is at her parents' place on September 20th. I'm making the cake.
Jakub's father has been in hospital since Monday with pneumonia. Jakub sounded exhausted on the phone. Message him tomorrow evening.
Note to self: dentist on Nov 3 at 9:15, then straight to the office.
Michael Kowalski from next door told me his son is getting married in Kraków next summer. He's a bit stressed about the speech already.
Theo's mum has just been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. He's been reading everything he can find about it and is trying to get her to change her diet.
Remind me to send flowers to Phoebe and Theo the day after their engagement party. It's on December 6.
Aiko is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Keep that in mind for the dinner.
Georgia's daughter Mai has been off school with tonsillitis again. That's the third time this term, and the GP is finally referring her to ENT.
Ali and his wife celebrated their first anniversary yesterday. He took her to the same restaurant where they had their first date.
Need to ring Santiago before Thursday. He's having his wisdom teeth out that afternoon and wanted someone to collect him afterwards.

Spoke to Lila about her brother Jorge. He's had a rough few months since the divorce, and now he's broken his ankle playing five-a-side. She's going to stay with him for a week to help out, even though her own kids are only small. Their mum isn't well enough to travel. I should offer to have her two for an afternoon while she's away.
Rachel and her partner Luca are finally tying the knot on 7/19. Small ceremony, just family, then a big party in the evening.
Eduardo hurt his back lifting boxes during the move. He's on strong painkillers and can't sit at a desk for long.
Uncle Michael is having his cataract operation on Feb 2nd. Mum's taking him in, and I'm doing the school run that day.
Don't forget to check in with Niamh a week after her surgery. She goes in on January 15.
Arjun Banerjee's dad is recovering well from his heart bypass. Arjun says he's already back to walking the dog every morning.

Ethan and Sara's wedding was beautiful. The speeches were hilarious, and her dad managed to get through his without crying, which nobody expected. Must send them the photos I took at the reception, and ask Sara how the honeymoon in Japan went once they're back on the 10th.
Ayo is nervous about her driving test on Friday. It's her third attempt. I should text her good luck the night before.
Hoang works as a nurse in A&E at St Thomas'. He says winter is already starting to bite and they're short-staffed.

Tamar's cat Pickle went missing on Monday. She's put up posters around the whole estate and is checking the shelters every day. Her kids are heartbroken and keep leaving food out on the back step. If he's not back by the weekend I said I'd help her post in the local Facebook groups.

Long chat with Magda last night. Her mum was diagnosed with early-stage Alzheimer's in the spring, and things have got noticeably worse since then. Magda and her sister are taking turns staying over at weekends, but she's worried it isn't sustainable. They have a meeting with the care team on November 18. I said I'd help her look into local day centres. Remind me to ring her the evening after the meeting to see how it went.
Book the restaurant for our anniversary on April 21st. Somewhere quiet, maybe the Italian place on Hill Street.
Yetunde's son Ayo has glandular fever and is missing a big chunk of his A-level term. She's worried about him falling behind.
Remember: Jakub and Ioana's wedding is on June 14th in Gdańsk. The rehearsal dinner is the night before, and there's a brunch the morning after. Need to book flights soon.
Alfie's grandad turns ninety on 3/8. The family is throwing a surprise party for him at the cricket club.
Luis mentioned his partner Adebayo has been struggling with migraines and is finally seeing a neurologist next week.

Just got off the phone with Raf. Rafael Barros, I mean, from uni. He's moved to Porto with his wife and they've just had twins! Born on September 30th, a boy and a girl. Remind me to send a card and something small for the babies.
Phoebe hates surprises, so don't let anyone plan one for her fortieth.
Georgia sprained her ankle at netball on Wednesday. She's on crutches for at least two weeks and is gutted about missing the tournament on the 2nd.
Note: cancel the gym membership before the end of the month, and renew the passport.

Mai and Hoang are celebrating their silver wedding anniversary on October 25th. Their kids are organising a dinner at the Thai place they love, and I've been invited along with Georgia and her husband. Hoang let slip that Mai has always wanted a proper silver locket, so that might be the gift. Should sort it the week before.
Ruby's little boy Ethan is having grommets put in on Tuesday. She says he's fine about it but she's a bag of nerves. Text her that afternoon to see how it went.
Tamar told me that her sister Sara is engaged to a guy called Michael she met through work. The wedding's planned for next spring, probably in Tel Aviv.
Aiko's mother-in-law is visiting from Osaka for the whole of December. Aiko is a bit apprehensive, they don't always get on.
Santiago Fernández asked whether I can be a reference for his new job. I said yes. Need to email him my details by Wednesday.
Uma has been feeling really low since the miscarriage in the summer. She's started seeing a counsellor every Tuesday, which seems to be helping a bit.
Luca's anniversary trip to Paris got cancelled because his wife came down with flu. They've rebooked for the weekend after Valentine's.
Remind me to ask Niamh how her dad's results came back. He had the biopsy on Monday and they said about ten days.
Ali's mum is having a hip replacement on December 1. Ali is taking the week off to look after her. Drop him a message the day before, and maybe pop round with a curry a few days after.
Lovely evening at Eduardo and Lila's. Their daughter is learning the cello and played for us after dinner.
